articles.summary: 2026.10.7 Highlights Replay-safe session recovery: interrupted sessions now retain recovery provenance and unfinished tool outcomes, stopped conversations retire terminal recovery residue before accepting the next message, rejected Claude CLI drafts stay out of final replies, large child-completion batches stay within requester context, and Codex previews no longer block replies after a context refresh. articles.title: Cognition Open-Sources an Agent Plugin that Helps Secure Systems against Recent Cybersecurity Threats
articles.summary: Cognition released the Devin Vulnerability Fixes plugin, 3 MIT-licensed agent skills that inventory, patch and test PHP, Node.js and self-managed GitLab deployments hit by this week’s critical RCE flaws, then open 1 PR per repo. The post Cognition Open-Sources an Agent Plugin that Helps Secure Systems against Recent Cybersecurity Threats appeared first on MarkTechPost .

articles.summary: Verifying the artifacts First, download the checksums.txt file and the checksums.txt.sigstore.json file files, for example, with wget : wget ' https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/nightly/checksums.txt ' wget ' https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/nightly/checksums.txt.sigstore.json ' Then, verify it using cosign : cosign verify-blob \ --certificate-identity-regexp ' ^https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/\.github/workflows/(release|nightly)\.yml@ ' \ --certificate-oidc-issuer ' https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ' \ --bundle '...
